# @oge-ui/react-kanban

> React Kanban board: columns + swimlanes over a plain card array with field mapping, WIP limits, per-column virtualization, drag & drop with Escape-cancel and edge auto-scroll, Ctrl+Arrow keyboard card moving with live announcements, cancelable CRUD and move callbacks, built-in edit dialog, context menu and toolbar — running the same engine and stylesheet as the Angular Kanban package.
>
> This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://ogeui.com/license before shipping it.

Part of OGE UI v0.13.1.
Docs and live demos: https://ogeui.com/components/kanban
Whole-suite reference: https://ogeui.com/llms-full.txt

```sh
npm i @oge-ui/react-kanban
```

## Writing OGE React code

Follow these rules and generated code compiles on the first try.

1. **These are plain React components.** Import the component and render it:
   `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'`. There is no module, no
   provider requirement and no `imports` array — that is the Angular package.
2. **Import the stylesheet once, at your app entry.**
   `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'`. Components ship no inline
   styles; without this import they render unstyled.
3. **Props are plain props, not signals.** Write `text="Save"`,
   `severity="accent"`, `disabled`. Never call them (`text()`), and never use
   `[prop]`/`[(prop)]` binding syntax — that is Angular template syntax.
4. **Modes are string unions, never enums.** Write the literal:
   `severity="danger"`, `stylingMode="outlined"`, `size="sm"`,
   `selectionMode="single"`. There is no `OgeButtonSeverity.Danger`.
5. **Events are `on*` callbacks taking the payload directly** —
   `onClick={(event) => …}`, `onActionDone={(result) => …}`,
   `onSelectionChange={(change) => …}`. Note this is the mirror image of the
   Angular naming rule: there, outputs drop the `on` prefix; here React's
   convention wins, and the payload is the argument rather than an event object.
6. **Two-way state is the controlled/uncontrolled pair.** Pass `selectedKeys`
   plus `onSelectionChange` to control it yourself, or `defaultSelectedKeys`
   to let the component own it. Same for the button's `loading` /
   `onLoadingChange`.
7. **App-wide defaults and every user-facing string** come from a context
   provider: `<OgeButtonsConfigProvider config={{ clickGuardMs: 300,
   messages: { loading: 'Yükleniyor' } }}>`. That is how localization works;
   there is no i18n dependency. Per-instance overrides use the `messages` prop.
8. **Styling is CSS custom properties**, all prefixed `--oge-`, identical to
   the Angular packages — the two render layers share one stylesheet. Never
   target internal class names; override the token.
9. **Slots are props that take nodes**, not children with directives:
   `icon={<SaveIcon />}`. Free `children` render inside the button after the
   label.
10. **Server components:** every component is a client component
    (`'use client'` is already in the package). Import them from a client
    component, or mark your own file `'use client'`.

### Theming

```css
:root {
  --oge-accent: #4f46e5;   /* selection, focus, primary actions */
  --oge-radius-lg: 10px;
}
```

The theme stylesheets are shared with the Angular packages and ship in
`@oge-ui/core` (installed with every package; add it directly under pnpm):
`@oge-ui/core/themes/dark.css` (then `class="oge-theme-dark"` or
`data-oge-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or any subtree; `"auto"` follows
`prefers-color-scheme`), plus the `tailwind.css` and `bootstrap.css`
bridges.

## Common mistakes

Predictable wrong guesses, and what to write instead.

| Wrong | Right |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/buttons'` | `from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'` — the unprefixed package is Angular |
| `imports: [OgeButton]` | nothing — just render `<OgeButton />` |
| `[text]="label"` / `[(loading)]="busy"` | `text={label}` / `loading={busy} onLoadingChange={setBusy}` |
| `(clicked)="save()"` | `onClick={save}` |
| `onClick={(e) => e.cancel = true}` | there is no cancelable pre-event on the React buttons |
| `severity={OgeButtonSeverity.Danger}` | `severity="danger"` |
| forgetting the stylesheet | `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'` once at the app entry |
| `<OgeButton icon="save" />` | `icon={<SaveIcon />}` — slots take nodes |
| `::part` / overriding `.oge-button-native` | override a `--oge-*` token |
| rendering it from a server component | mark the file `'use client'` |

## API reference

### <OgeKanban>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Card items — a plain array, copied into an internal working set; the array is never mutated. A new array re-seeds the board. Edits surface through the past-tense callbacks. |
| `keyExpr / columnExpr / titleExpr / descriptionExpr / colorExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'id' / 'status' / 'title' / 'description' / 'color'` | Card field mapping: names (dotted paths reach nested objects) or getter functions. `columnExpr` holds the card's column key; a card with no resolvable column lands in the untitled column instead of being dropped. |
| `orderExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Numeric in-column sort order. Unset, the array order is the board order and moves reorder the working set; set, moves write a midpoint order value back onto the item (sequential renumber of the cell when the midpoint has no room). |
| `swimlaneExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Set = the board renders collapsible swimlane rows (first-seen data order); each lane holds every column. |
| `tagsExpr / assigneeExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Tag chips and assignee avatars (initials). Both accept a single value _or_ an array — write-back preserves the storage shape. |
| `dueDateExpr / priorityExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Due-date badge (danger when overdue; formatted through `locale`) and the priority indicator (colored by value: `'low'` green, `'medium'`/`'normal'` amber, `'high'`/`'urgent'`/`'critical'` red). |
| `searchExprs` | `readonly (string \| ((item: T) => unknown))[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Extra fields the toolbar search matches, beyond the built-in title + description + tags + assignees haystack. Matching is fold-insensitive (accents, Turkish İ/i). |
| `columns` | `readonly OgeKanbanColumn[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Declared columns (`{ key, title?, color?, wipLimit?, minCount?, collapsed?, allowAdding?, allowDrag?, allowDrop?, transitionColumns? }`); unset = derived from the data's distinct column keys in first-seen order. Cards in undeclared columns stay in the data but leave the view. |

_State (controlled / uncontrolled)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsedColumns / collapsedSwimlanes` | `readonly string[]` | `uncontrolled, []` | Collapsed column keys (slim vertical pills) and collapsed swimlane keys. Controlled when provided; `defaultCollapsedColumns` / `defaultCollapsedSwimlanes` seed the uncontrolled state at mount. |
| `columnOrder` | `readonly string[]` | `uncontrolled, []` | Persisted column key order (empty = declared order); written by header drags when `allowColumnReordering` is on. `defaultColumnOrder` seeds it uncontrolled. |
| `selectedCardKey` | `unknown` | `uncontrolled, null` | The selected card's key — single selection. `defaultSelectedCardKey` seeds it uncontrolled. |
| `onCollapsedColumnsChange / onCollapsedSwimlanesChange / onColumnOrderChange / onSelectedCardKeyChange` | `(value) => void` | `—` | The controlled halves of the four state props — Angular's `[(…)]` models are both halves at once. |

_Behavior_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `virtualScrolling` | `boolean` | `true` | Per-column card windowing over a fixed `cardHeight` — 10k cards stay smooth. Rich variable-height render props may opt out (`false`), the documented exception. |
| `cardHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined (config: 112)` | Fixed card height in px; also drives the drag hit-testing and the keyboard scroll-into-view math. |
| `showToolbar` | `boolean` | `true` | The built-in toolbar: primary add button, collapse/expand-all pill and the search box. |
| `allowAdding / allowUpdating / allowDeleting / allowDragging / allowColumnReordering / allowColumnAdding` | `boolean` | `true / true / true / true / false / false` | Capability gates for the toolbar, dialog, menu, hover quick actions, keyboard shortcuts and drags. `allowColumnAdding` renders the "+ Add column" ghost column (inline composer → cancelable `onColumnAdding` → `onColumnAdded`). Per-column `allowAdding: false` overrides the board. |
| `columnWidth` | `number` | `300` | Fixed column track width in px — headers stay legible and the board scrolls horizontally, Trello-style. |
| `cardColorMode` | `'stripe' \| 'surface'` | `'stripe'` | How `colorExpr` renders: an accent bar on the card's edge, or the whole card surface tinted with the color. |
| `dialogItems` | `readonly OgeFormItemDefinition[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Replaces the edit dialog's default form wholesale (`<OgeForm>` items from `@oge-ui/react-forms`); `onCardEditDialogShowing` can still adjust per open. The default form only renders editors for fields the board actually maps. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | One switch over every `allow*` capability; the context menu falls back to the browser's native menu. |
| `messages / locale` | `Partial<OgeKanbanMessages> / string \| undefined` | `{} / undefined` | Per-instance overrides of the context config (`<OgeKanbanConfigProvider>`). Every user-facing string, aria labels and live-region templates included, lives in the messages interface; `locale` drives every Intl format. |

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderCard` | `(context: OgeKanbanCardRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | Replaces the card body (`{ card, column, swimlane }`, the card with its `source`). Drag, keyboard and ARIA stay on the board — the React face of `*ogeKanbanCardTemplate`. |
| `renderColumnHeader` | `(context: OgeKanbanColumnHeaderRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces the column header's title row (`{ column, count, wip }`); the add and collapse affordances stay — the React face of `*ogeKanbanColumnHeaderTemplate`. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | Host styling, merged onto the `.oge-kanban` element (give the board a height, as with the Angular host). |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addCard(item)` | `(item: T) => void` | Programmatic insert through the cancelable `onCardAdding` pipeline; the column and swimlane resolve from the item's own fields. |
| `updateCard(original, updated)` | `(original: T, updated: T) => void` | Programmatic update through the cancelable `onCardUpdating` pipeline. |
| `deleteCard(item)` | `(item: T) => void` | Programmatic delete through the cancelable `onCardDeleting` pipeline. |
| `moveCard(key, toColumn, toIndex?, toSwimlane?)` | `(key: unknown, toColumn: string, toIndex?: number, toSwimlane?: string \| null) => void` | Moves a card (append when `toIndex` is omitted) through the cancelable `onCardMoving` pipeline — the same path the drag, the Ctrl+Arrow twin and the context menu commit through. |
| `editCard(card) / openNewCard(column, swimlane)` | `(…) => void` | Opens the built-in dialog for an existing card / prefilled for a new card, through the `onCardEditDialogShowing` hook. |
| `closeDialog()` | `() => void` | Closes the edit dialog without saving; fires `onCardEditDialogHidden`. |
| `collapseAllColumns() / expandAllColumns()` | `() => void` | The toolbar buttons, callable from code. |

#### Events

_Callbacks_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onCardClick / onCardDblClick / onCardContextMenu` | `(event: OgeKanbanCardEvent<T>) => void` | Pointer interactions with a card (`{ card, event }`, the native `MouseEvent`). Double-click also opens the editor; right-click fires _before_ the built-in menu opens, so app handlers can coexist with it. |
| `onCardAdding / onCardUpdating / onCardDeleting / onCardMoving` | `(event: Oge…Event<T>) => void (mutable cancel)` | Cancelable pre-events — set `event.cancel = true` to veto. `onCardMoving` carries `{ card, fromColumn, toColumn, fromIndex, toIndex, fromSwimlane, toSwimlane }` and guards drags, keyboard moves and programmatic moves alike. |
| `onCardAdded / onCardUpdated / onCardDeleted / onCardMoved` | `(event: Oge…Event<T>) => void` | Past-tense callbacks fire only for applied changes and carry the data to persist (`onCardMoved`'s `card` is the _updated_ item, orderExpr write-back included). |
| `onCardEditDialogShowing` | `(event: OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable + customization point before the dialog opens: `formItems` arrives pre-populated with the default `<OgeForm>` items and may be mutated or replaced (dx `onAppointmentFormOpening` parity). |
| `onCardEditDialogHidden` | `() => void` | The edit dialog closed — saved, cancelled, deleted or `closeDialog()` (Syncfusion `dialogClose` parity). |
| `onColumnReordered` | `(event: OgeKanbanColumnReorderedEvent) => void` | A header drag committed a new order: `{ column, fromIndex, toIndex, columnOrder }`. |
| `onColumnAdding / onColumnAdded` | `(event: OgeKanbanColumnAddingEvent / OgeKanbanColumnAddedEvent) => void` | The "+ Add column" composer's cancelable pre-event and its past-tense commit. |

#### Types

_Render contexts_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanCardRenderContext<T>` | `interface` | `{ card, column, swimlane }` — what `renderCard` is handed (the context of Angular's `*ogeKanbanCardTemplate`, `$implicit` named `card`). |
| `OgeKanbanColumnHeaderRenderContext` | `interface` | `{ column, count, wip }` — what `renderColumnHeader` is handed. An OGE extra — no reference library templates its headers. |

_Configuration_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanConfigProvider` | `({ config?: OgeKanbanConfigInput, children }) => JSX` | The React counterpart of `provideOgeKanbanConfig()`: `messages` (merged block by block), `locale`, `cardHeight` for the subtree. Nested providers merge over the outer one, and a new `config` re-resolves the subtree — switching the UI language at runtime is a state change. |
| `useOgeKanbanConfig` | `() => OgeKanbanConfig` | The resolved config for the current subtree (the counterpart of `inject(OGE_KANBAN_CONFIG)`). |
| `OgeKanbanMessages` | `interface` | Every user-facing string: `toolbar`, `menu`, `dialog`, `board` (aria label templates with `{title}`/`{count}`/`{limit}` tokens) and `announcements` (live-region templates). Single-sourced in `@oge-ui/kanban-engine` with the Angular package. |
| `OgeKanbanColumn` | `interface` | `{ key, title?, color?, wipLimit?, minCount?, collapsed?, allowAdding?, allowDrag?, allowDrop?, transitionColumns? }` — the declared column shape. `wipLimit`/`minCount` drive the danger/warning badges; `allowDrag`/`allowDrop`/`transitionColumns` gate interactive moves (programmatic `moveCard` is deliberately not gated). |
| `OgeKanbanCard<T>` | `interface` | The normalized card handed to render props and callbacks: `key`, `source` (your item, unchanged), `column`, `title`, `description`, `color`, `order`, `swimlane`, `tags`, `assignees`, `dueDate`, `priority`. |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### Getting started

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const columns = [
  { key: 'todo', title: 'To do', color: '#64748b' },
  { key: 'doing', title: 'In progress', color: '#2563eb', wipLimit: 3 },
  { key: 'review', title: 'Review', color: '#d97706' },
  { key: 'done', title: 'Done', color: '#16a34a' },
];

const tasks = [
  {
    id: 1,
    status: 'doing',
    title: 'Checkout revamp',
    notes: 'New payment flow behind the feature flag',
    owner: 'Ada Lovelace',
    due: new Date(2026, 7, 21),
    priority: 'high',
    labels: ['feature'],
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    status: 'todo',
    title: 'Wallet UI polish',
    owner: ['Grace Hopper', 'Alan Turing'],
    priority: 'medium',
    labels: ['design'],
  },
  { id: 3, status: 'todo', title: 'Upgrade CI runners', priority: 'low' },
  {
    id: 4,
    status: 'review',
    title: 'Fix login crash',
    notes: 'Repro: expired refresh token',
    owner: 'Ada Lovelace',
    due: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    priority: 'high',
    labels: ['bug'],
  },
  { id: 5, status: 'done', title: 'Q3 roadmap draft' },
];

export function TaskBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* One element, a working board. Any item shape binds through the
          *Expr props — field names, dotted paths or getter functions. Columns can
          be declared (with titles, colors and WIP limits) or derived from the data.
          Drag a card between columns (Escape cancels mid-drag), double-click to
          edit, right-click for the built-in menu, type in the toolbar to search,
          and add a column at the board's end (allowColumnAdding). The edit
          dialog only offers editors for fields the board maps. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        descriptionExpr="notes"
        assigneeExpr="owner"
        dueDateExpr="due"
        priorityExpr="priority"
        tagsExpr="labels"
        columns={columns}
        allowColumnAdding
        style={{ height: 520 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Swimlanes

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, team: 'Platform', status: 'doing', title: 'Sharding rollout' },
  { id: 2, team: 'Platform', status: 'todo', title: 'Postgres 18 upgrade' },
  { id: 3, team: 'Mobile', status: 'todo', title: 'Push notification opt-in' },
  { id: 4, team: 'Mobile', status: 'done', title: 'Biometric login' },
  { id: 5, team: 'Web', status: 'doing', title: 'Design token migration' },
];

export function TeamBoard() {
  const [collapsedLanes, setCollapsedLanes] = useState<readonly string[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      {/* swimlaneExpr turns the board into swimlane rows × columns. Lane
          headers collapse (collapsedSwimlanes + onCollapsedSwimlanesChange is a
          controlled pair, like collapsedColumns); every lane scrolls its column
          cells independently. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        swimlaneExpr="team"
        columns={[
          { key: 'todo', title: 'To do' },
          { key: 'doing', title: 'In progress' },
          { key: 'done', title: 'Done' },
        ]}
        collapsedSwimlanes={collapsedLanes}
        onCollapsedSwimlanesChange={setCollapsedLanes}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### WIP limits

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'doing', title: 'Payments API' },
  { id: 2, status: 'doing', title: 'Search relevance' },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'One too many — WIP exceeded' },
  { id: 4, status: 'todo', title: 'Docs sweep' },
  { id: 5, status: 'done', title: 'Login rate limits' },
];

export function WipBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* wipLimit is a soft limit: the column count badge shows count/limit,
          turns to the danger tone on overflow, and previews the target column's
          +1 while a drag hovers it. Limits count real data — search filtering
          never changes them. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        columns={[
          { key: 'todo', title: 'To do' },
          { key: 'doing', title: 'In progress', wipLimit: 2 },
          { key: 'done', title: 'Done' },
        ]}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Drag & drop pipeline

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanCardMovingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Refactor auth', rank: 0 },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Ship dark mode', rank: 1 },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'Bundle size audit', rank: 0 },
  { id: 4, status: 'done', title: 'This card is locked in', rank: 0 },
];

function onMoving(event: OgeKanbanCardMovingEvent): void {
  // veto example: nothing may leave "done"
  if (event.fromColumn === 'done') event.cancel = true;
}

export function GuardedBoard() {
  const [log, setLog] = useState('drag a card');
  return (
    <>
      {/* Every move — drag, Ctrl+Arrow or moveCard() — runs the same
          cancelable pipeline: onCardMoving (set cancel = true to veto) then
          onCardMoved with {card, fromColumn, toColumn, fromIndex, toIndex}.
          Mid-drag Escape restores everything. orderExpr persists the in-column
          order back onto your items; without it the array order is the board
          order. Column headers drag too (allowColumnReordering). */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        orderExpr="rank"
        allowColumnReordering
        onCardMoving={onMoving}
        onCardMoved={(e) => setLog(`moved: ${e.toColumn} @ ${e.toIndex}`)}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
      <p>{log}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Keyboard moving & a11y

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Tab to the board, then arrow around' },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Ctrl+ArrowRight moves me' },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'Enter opens my dialog' },
];

export function KeyboardBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Full keyboard board: arrows rove between cards and columns, Enter
          edits, Delete deletes, and Ctrl+Arrow MOVES the focused card — the
          exact keyboard twin of the drag, with a polite live-region
          announcement ("… moved to …, position 2 of 3") after every commit.
          Columns are labeled listboxes; cards are options. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Edit dialog & events

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Double-click me', notes: 'Custom form field below' },
  { id: 2, status: 'doing', title: 'Right-click me for the menu' },
];

function onDialogShowing(event: OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent): void {
  // drop the color field and add a sprint picker
  event.formItems = [
    ...event.formItems.filter((item) => item.field !== 'color'),
    {
      field: 'sprint',
      label: 'Sprint',
      editorType: 'selectBox',
      editorOptions: { items: ['Sprint 41', 'Sprint 42', 'Sprint 43'] },
    },
  ];
}

export function DialogBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* The built-in dialog (an <OgeForm>) covers the standard fields;
          onCardEditDialogShowing is both the veto and the customization point —
          formItems arrives pre-populated and may be mutated or replaced. Saves
          and deletes run the cancelable onCardUpdating / onCardDeleting
          pipelines; new cards go through onCardAdding. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        descriptionExpr="notes"
        onCardEditDialogShowing={onDialogShowing}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Card template

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanCard } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const deployments = [
  { id: 1, stage: 'staging', service: 'api-gateway', version: 'v2.14.0', health: 98 },
  { id: 2, stage: 'staging', service: 'search', version: 'v1.9.2', health: 74 },
  { id: 3, stage: 'production', service: 'billing', version: 'v3.1.1', health: 100 },
];

function field(card: OgeKanbanCard, name: string): string {
  return String((card.source as Record<string, unknown>)[name] ?? '');
}

export function DeploymentBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* renderCard replaces the card body while drag, keyboard and ARIA stay
          on the board. card.source is your original item (typed unknown —
          narrow it in a helper). Rich templates usually pair with a matching
          cardHeight, or opt out of virtualization entirely
          (virtualScrolling={false}) when heights must vary. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={deployments}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="stage"
        titleExpr="service"
        cardHeight={96}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
        renderCard={({ card }) => (
          <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            <strong>{card.title}</strong>
            <code style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{field(card, 'version')}</code>
            <progress value={Number(field(card, 'health'))} max={100} style={{ width: '100%' }} />
          </div>
        )}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Configuration & i18n

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

// App-wide (wrap the tree once; a new config object re-resolves every
// board below it, so switching the UI language is a state change):
// <OgeKanbanConfigProvider
//   config={{
//     locale: 'de-DE',
//     cardHeight: 104,
//     messages: {
//       toolbar: {
//         label: 'Kanban-Werkzeugleiste',
//         addCard: 'Neue Karte',
//         collapseAll: 'Alle einklappen',
//         expandAll: 'Alle ausklappen',
//         searchLabel: 'Karten durchsuchen',
//         searchPlaceholder: 'Suchen…',
//         clearSearch: 'Suche löschen',
//       },
//     },
//   }}
// >

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'Offen', title: 'Angebot schreiben', due: new Date(2026, 7, 14) },
  { id: 2, status: 'In Arbeit', title: 'Rechnung prüfen' },
  { id: 3, status: 'Fertig', title: 'Kickoff-Termin' },
];

export function GermanBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Every user-facing string — toolbar, menu, dialog, aria labels,
          live-region announcements — lives in OgeKanbanMessages. Provide once
          (OgeKanbanConfigProvider), override per instance with messages; locale
          drives every Intl format (due-date badges). */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        dueDateExpr="due"
        locale="de-DE"
        style={{ height: 380 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
